# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility to generate a safe HTML representation of a forum post. """ from html import escape from typing import List # Example template; in real usage this should be defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT: str = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html( author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML snippet for a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Name of the user who authored the post. post_title : str Title (headline) of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. post_tags : list[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing the formatted, escaped HTML representation of the post. """ # Escape all user supplied strings to prevent XSS safe_author = escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_content = escape(content) # Build the tags HTML; each tag is wrapped in a safe_tags = "".join( f'{escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author_name=safe_author, content=safe_content, tags=safe_tags ) return html_output.strip()
